subject: Monthly Research Report
synthesis: Synthesis Work on Sclerosol As stated in the previous report, work has been recently undertaken to synthesize a number of new derivatives of sclerosol with emphasis being directed toward compounds which may exhibit useful flavor or physiological properties.
work_to_date: Work to date has been concentrated on the synthesis of a number of nitrogen-containing derivatives of methyl sclerosolate (I), sclerosolide (II) and the actoxy acid (III), all oxidation products of sclerosol.
neiratr: Derivatives of Methyl Sclerosolate: Methyl sclerosolate upon refluxing in morpholine or piperidine failed to give the expected amides but was saponified to yield instead the amine salt of sclerosolic acid. It is thought that steric hindrance of the carboxmethoxy group coupled with a small amount of water in the amine accounts for this reaction. Derivatives of Sclerosolide The following compounds were obtained by treatment of sclerosolide with appropriate amines and by reduction of the resulting amides with lithium aluminum hydride. It is noteworthy that reduction of the ethanolamide was accompanied by cyclization in the case of SF3E. (Continued p. 1 inset)
